summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is for creating a new post. The main contents and functions include:

1. **Title Bar**: At the top, there is a title bar with the text "पोस्ट करें" (Post) indicating the purpose of the screen.
2. **Back Button**: A back arrow on the left side of the title bar allows the user to navigate back to the previous screen.
3. **Submit Button**: A green checkmark on the right side of the title bar is likely the button to submit or post the content.
4. **Text Input Area**: Below the title bar, there is a text input area with a placeholder text suggesting to post jokes, shayari (poetry), status updates, etc.
5. **Character Requirement Notification**: A message in the middle of the screen indicates that at least 50 characters are required to post.
6. **Media Options**: At the bottom, there are options to add images, videos, audio
